title: Parity-Reduced Transverse Wronskians, Jensen-Laguerre Moment Identities, and Division-Free Interval Enclosures for Riemann's Xi-Function
description:
Let W(d,t) = (1/2) ∂d|Ξ(t − id)|2 be the transverse Wronskian of Riemann's completed function Ξ(t − id). Factoring d analytically via sinchyp(2dy) = sinh(2dy)/(2dy) yields the canonical parity-reduced representation W̃(d,t) = W(d,t)/d = 32 ∫0∞ y2 sinchyp(2dy) I(y,t) dy, whose Maclaurin coefficients c2m−1(t) = m Lm(Ξ;t) recover the classical differential invariants of Jensen (1913) and Csordas–Varga (1990), with W̃(0,t) = L1(Ξ;t) = (Ξ'(t))2 − Ξ(t)Ξ''(t). Using positive-weight integral representations of sinchyp and ηhyp, we construct division-free Cauchy–Riemann gradients and non-harmonic-safe two-dimensional interval mean-value enclosures in mpmath.iv, benchmarked on t ≤ 55 alongside a quantitative Higham |x|T|y| roundoff-amplification audit of IEEE-754 float64 quadrature.

This repository contains the 13-page AMS-LaTeX manuscript, native pdfTeX PDF, 300-DPI vector figures, AI agent skill specification, and standalone verification suite (scripts/verify_paper2_parity_reduced_wronskian.py).
notes: AMS-LaTeX preprint (13 pages, 4 tables, 2 figures) with companion mpmath.iv interval benchmark and IEEE-754 float64 cancellation audit. Part II of the series on the transverse Wronskian of Riemann's Xi-function (Part I: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23637324).
